sources_considered.why: Full Reuters report based on a confidential prospectus; useful for the pre-post estimate when the underlying draft was not publicly available.

Primary filing available by the evaluation date distinguishes fixed commitments from agreements without a determinable minimum. Later amendments prevent treating every disclosed amount as the September snapshot.
Read the relevant passage. It describes an $800 billion OpenAI spending plan, not a reconciled outstanding contractual balance, and was published after the post.

evidence_items.explanation: The report identifies Google, Amazon and Microsoft obligations alongside the Broadcom leases. Their nominal sum is $413.7 billion, but the report's qualifications and the absence of an OpenAI reconciliation prevent verification of the complete claim.

metric_scope.metric: Reported nominal Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Broadcom compute obligations

derived.formula: 111.1 + 110 + 31.4 + 161.2 = 413.7 billion USD in nominal reported obligations; this is not a verified remaining uncancellable balance.
derived.rounding: One decimal place; preserves the approximate nature of the inputs.

evidence_items.locator: Note 13, Commitments and Contingencies — Purchase Commitments, F-59
evidence_items.explanation: The filing separates fixed or minimum guaranteed payments from other agreements whose payments depend on delivery, capacity and pricing. Its June financial snapshot and company-reported basis are not directly comparable to the combined September press estimate.

metric_scope.metric: Fixed or minimum guaranteed purchase commitments, excluding agreements without determinable minimum payments

unresolved_gaps: No complete OpenAI schedule reconciles outstanding obligations to the combined $1.3 trillion figure.
